title: Catalog pods restarting
summary: catalog-api pods began restarting repeatedly several hours after v2.7.0

metrics.catalog.memory_rss: 620MiB after restart; grows linearly to 2048MiB over 3 hours

logs: catalog-api INFO cache entries=184220 and increasing
kubelet WARN container catalog-api terminated reason=OOMKilled
deployments: catalog-api v2.7.0 enabled unbounded product-detail cache at 09:10Z

runbooks.title: Progressive memory growth
runbooks.content: Linear memory growth ending at the container limit with OOMKilled restarts indicates retained allocations. Compare recent cache or buffering changes and roll back before raising limits.

oracle.root_cause: The unbounded product-detail cache introduced in catalog-api v2.7.0 retained entries until the 2048MiB limit caused OOMKilled restarts.
